title: [finding] the `域车道` table in pm-dispatch SKILL.md has no entry for `docs/qa/**`, so checklist-area cards are routed by judgment call
body:
Filed by the triage seat while grading #17453, which lands in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json`.

## The gap

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`'s `域车道` table enumerates the package families for each `domain:*`. `docs/qa/**` appears in **none** of them:

- `domain:devx` names `content/docs/**` and `apps/docs`, not `docs/qa/**`.
- The catch-all row `(无固定归属,按落点分诊)` names `docs/audits/**` — the neighbouring docs tree — but not `docs/qa/**`.

So a card whose fix lands in a checklist area file has no lookup, and the anchoring rule (`domain:*` = the domain of the package the fix lands in) does not resolve it either, because the file is not in a package.

## Why it is not just a missing row

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/` has a real reader set, and they do not agree on one lane:

- `.claude/skills/checklist-author/SKILL.md` and `checklist-test/SKILL.md` author it ⇒ governed surface, `domain:skills`.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/*.dogfood.test.ts` consume it ⇒ `domain:cli`.
- `scripts/check-doc-authoring.mjs` and `.github/workflows/platform-checklist-watchdog.yml` gate it ⇒ `domain:devx`.
- The **content** of any one area file is subject-matter documentation for whatever subsystem the area covers (`approvals.json` documents the approvals/auth surface ⇒ `domain:services`).

`.github/CODEOWNERS` has no `docs/qa` rule, so it settles nothing either. Four defensible answers with nothing in the text to choose between them is exactly the shape the anchoring rule exists to prevent.

## What I did in the absence of a rule, so it is on the record

I routed #17453 **`domain:services`** on the principle the table already applies to the other docs tree — *docs follow the surface they document* — because the rewrite needs the auth retirement in the writer's head. I did not route it `domain:devx` on "it is a docs file", because under that reading every checklist area collapses into one lane regardless of subject.

That is a triage judgment call standing in for a rule, and it will be made again, differently, by the next seat.

## The fix

One row, or one sentence, in the `域车道` table: state whether `docs/qa/**` routes by documented subject (per area) or to a single lane, and say which. If per-subject, the sentence should generalise rather than enumerate areas — new area files land without a table edit.

## Related, not duplicate

#17088 (`domain:skills` / `pm:queue` / `priority:p3`) is the same lane and adjacent subject — it records that `references/lanes/engine.md:15` states `packages/lint` ⇒ `domain:devx` with no exception noted. Different file, different claim; whoever takes either may fold them if the five folding gates hold. ⛔ Not folding them here — that is the dispatching seat's call, not triage's.

**Dedupe:** searched the open board for `docs/qa.*(lane|domain:)` (0 hits), `lane table` (2 hits: #17088, #15240 — neither is this), `域车道.*表` (1 hit: #17088). ⚠️ Firing control: the `lane table` and `域车道` patterns both returned #17088, so a zero is a zero. ⚠️ Gap in the dedupe: the global `/search/issues` REST endpoint is refused for this session (`403 — sessions are bound to their configured repositories`), so this search covered the **cached open board only**; closed issues were not searched.
